description: E190. The words of kinds of work, of what applies to which, and of taking a step or a criterion out of one run, beside ophiolite.chain-reasons/1 and ophiolite.criteria-words/1, which are unchanged. `reasons`: why a declaration, a start or a take-out or put-back was refused, one closed key each, one sentence each; nothing was stored (the HTTP status of each is the service's `job_kinds.STATUS`). `not_applying`: the words a person reads for each cause of a step or a criterion that does not apply. `step_states`: the words of the state `does-not-apply`. `counts`: how many steps of a run apply. `unavailable`: the sentence every kinds-of-work request answers until it is served. Placeholders are in braces; no sentence carries a code.

reasons.duplicate-job-kind: Each kind of work is listed once.
reasons.applies-unknown-kind: A step or a criterion can only be limited to kinds of work this process lists.
reasons.applies-wider-than-step: A criterion cannot apply to a kind of work its step does not apply to.
reasons.applies-data-successor: A step cannot be limited to fewer kinds of work than a step made from its result.
reasons.applies-reads-limited: A condition, or a criterion that uses an earlier step's latest result, cannot read a step that applies to fewer kinds of work than its own.
reasons.job-kind-needed: Say which kind of work this run is: {kinds}.
reasons.job-kind-unknown: This process knows these kinds of work: {kinds}.
reasons.job-kind-not-here: This process lists no kinds of work; start it without one.
reasons.step-made-from: {step} is made from this step's result: take {step} out first, or both.
reasons.later-step-attached: A later step has a version attached, so this cannot be put back.
reasons.not-taken-out: This was not taken out of the run.
reasons.already-out: This does not apply to this run already.
reasons.step-rejected: A rejected step is not taken out: attach a new result, or the run stays stopped.

not_applying.taken-out: Does not apply: taken out by {person}: {reason}

counts: {applying} of {steps} steps apply; {not applying} do not
unavailable: Kinds of work and taking a step out of a run are not available on this deployment yet.
